Limits to human sporting performance are: Since the early years of the twentieth century, when the International Athletic Federation began keeping records, there has been a steady improvement in how fast athletes run, how high they jump and how far they are able to hurl massive objects, themselves included, through space.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 自20世纪初国际田径联合会开始记录运动员成绩以来，运动员的跑步速度、跳跃高度以及投掷物体的能力都得到了稳步提升。当然，这其中也包括了运动员自身的表现。

Limits to human sporting performance are: For the so-called power events — that require a relatively brief, explosive release of energy, like the 100-metre sprint and the long jump — times and distances have improved ten to twenty per cent.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 对于那些需要快速、爆发性释放能量的运动项目来说——比如100米短跑和跳远——时间和距离的表现已经提升了10%到20%。

Limits to human sporting performance are: In the endurance events the results have been more dramatic.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 在耐力项目中，成绩提升更为显著。

Limits to human sporting performance are: At the 1908 Olympics, John Hayes of the U.S.team ran a marathon in a time of 2:55:18.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 在1908年奥运会上，美国队的约翰·海斯以2小时55分18秒的成绩完成了马拉松比赛。

Limits to human sporting performance are: In 1999, Morocco’s Khalid Khannouchi set a new world record of 2:05:42, almost thirty per cent faster.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 在1999年，摩洛哥的卡利德·卡努奇创下了新的世界纪录，成绩为2小时5分42秒，比之前的记录快了近30%。

Limits to human sporting performance are: No one theory can explain improvements in performance, but the most important factor has been genetics.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 没有一个理论能完全解释性能提升的原因，但最重要的因素是遗传。

Limits to human sporting performance are: ‘The athlete must choose his parents carefully,’ says Jesus Dapena, a sports scientist at Indiana University, invoking an oft-cited adage.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: ‘运动员必须谨慎选择自己的父母，’印第安纳大学的体育科学家耶稣·达佩纳说道。他引用了这句常被引用的谚语。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Over the past century, the composition of the human gene pool has not changed appreciably, but with increasing global participation in athletics — and greater rewards to tempt athletes — it is more likely that individuals possessing the unique complement of genes for athletic performance can be identified early.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 在过去的一个世纪里，人类基因库的构成并没有发生显著的变化。不过，随着全球范围内对体育运动的关注日益增加，以及为激励运动员而制定的更多奖励措施，那些拥有能够提升运动表现的特殊基因的人，就更有可能被及早识别出来。

Limits to human sporting performance are: ‘Was there someone like [sprinter] Michael Johnson in the 1920s?’
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 20世纪20年代有没有像短跑运动员迈克尔·约翰逊这样的人？

Limits to human sporting performance are: Dapena asks.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 达佩纳问道。

Limits to human sporting performance are: ‘I’m sure there was, but his talent was probably never realised.’
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 我确信当时是有的，但他的天赋可能从未被发挥出来。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Identifying genetically talented individuals is only the first step.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 识别具有遗传天赋的个体只是第一步。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Michael Yessis, an emeritus professor of Sports Science at California State University at Fullerton, maintains that ‘genetics only determines about one third of what an athlete can do.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 加州州立大学富勒顿分校的体育科学系名誉教授迈克尔·耶西斯指出，‘遗传因素只决定了运动员能力中的大约三分之一。’

Limits to human sporting performance are: But with the right training we can go much further with that one third than we’ve been going.’
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 但是，通过正确的训练，我们能够将那三分之一的潜力发挥到更极致的程度。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Yessis believes that U.S. runners, despite their impressive achievements, are ‘running on their genetics’.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 耶西斯认为，尽管美国跑者取得了令人瞩目的成绩，但他们仍‘依赖基因’。

Limits to human sporting performance are: By applying more scientific methods, ‘they’re going to go much faster’.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 通过采用更科学的方法，‘他们’将跑得更快。

Limits to human sporting performance are: These methods include strength training that duplicates what they are doing in their running events as well as plyometrics, a technique pioneered in the former Soviet Union.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 这些方法包括模仿跑步项目内容的力量训练，以及前苏联首创的跳跃训练技术。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Whereas most exercises are designed to build up strength or endurance, plyometrics focuses on increasing power — the rate at which an athlete can expend energy.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 虽然大多数锻炼都是为了增强力量或耐力而设计的，但爆发训练则着重于提升动力——即运动员消耗能量的速度。

Limits to human sporting performance are: When a sprinter runs, Yessis explains, her foot stays in contact with the ground for just under a tenth of a second, half of which is devoted to landing and the other half to pushing off.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: Yessis解释说，当一名短跑运动员奔跑时，她的脚与地面接触的时间不到十分之一秒，其中一半用于着陆，另一半用于蹬地。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Plyometric exercises help athletes make the best use of this brief interval.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 爆发式训练能够帮助运动员充分利用这段短暂的时间。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Nutrition is another area that sports trainers have failed to address adequately.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 营养也是运动训练师们未能充分应对的领域之一。

Limits to human sporting performance are: ‘Many athletes are not getting the best nutrition, even through supplements,’ Yessis insists.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: ‘许多运动员并未获得最佳营养，即使使用了补充剂，’耶西斯坚持说道。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Each activity has its own nutritional needs.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 每种活动都有其特定的营养需求。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Few coaches, for instance, understand how deficiencies in trace minerals can lead to injuries.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 例如，很少有教练理解微量元素缺乏会导致受伤。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Focused training will also play a role in enabling records to be broken.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 有针对性的训练也有助于打破记录的实现。

Limits to human sporting performance are: ‘If we applied the Russian training model to some of the outstanding runners we have in this country,’Yessis asserts, ‘they would be breaking records left and right.’
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: “如果我们把俄罗斯的训练模式应用到我们国家的一些优秀运动员身上，”耶西斯说道，“他们肯定会不断创造新的纪录。”

Limits to human sporting performance are: He will not predict by how much, however: ‘Exactly what the limits are it’s hard to say, but there will be increases even if only by hundredths of a second, as long as our training continues to improve.’
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 他无法精确预测提升的幅度：‘确切的界限是什么很难说，但只要训练持续改进，成绩就会不断上升，哪怕只是以百分之一秒为单位。’

Limits to human sporting performance are: One of the most important new methodologies is biomechanics, the study of the body in motion.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 其中最重要的新研究方法之一是生物力学，它研究的是运动中的身体。

Limits to human sporting performance are: A biomechanic films an athlete in action and then digitizes her performance, recording the motion of every joint and limb in three dimensions.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 生物力学通过拍摄运动员的动作，然后将其表现数字化，记录下每个关节和肢体的三维运动。

Limits to human sporting performance are: By applying Newton’s laws to these motions, ‘we can say that this athlete’s run is not fast enough; that this one is not using his arms strongly enough during take-off,’ says Dapena, who uses these methods to help high jumpers.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 通过将牛顿定律应用于这些动作，我们可以得出结论：这位运动员的奔跑速度不够快，另一位运动员在起跳时手臂发力不足。达佩纳利用这些方法来帮助跳高运动员提高成绩。

Limits to human sporting performance are: To date, however, biomechanics has made only a small difference to athletic performance.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 不过，到目前为止，生物力学对运动表现的影响仍然很小。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Revolutionary ideas still come from the athletes themselves.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 革命性的想法仍然来自运动员自身。

Limits to human sporting performance are: For example, during the 1968 Olympics in Mexico City, a relatively unknown high jumper named Dick Fosbury won the gold by going over the bar backwards, in complete contradiction of all the received high-jumping wisdom, a move instantly dubbed the Fosbury flop.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 例如，在1968年墨西哥城奥运会上，此前名气不大的跳高运动员迪克·福斯贝里背向横杆跃过，夺得金牌。这个动作完全颠覆了传统跳高观念，立即被称为“福斯贝里背越式”。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Fosbury himself did not know what he was doing.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 福斯伯里自己也不清楚自己在做什么。

Limits to human sporting performance are: That understanding took the later analysis of biomechanics specialists, who put their minds to comprehending something that was too complex and unorthodox ever to have been invented through their own mathematical simulations.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 这种理解是后来生物力学专家通过分析得出的，他们试图理解一个过于复杂且非正统的跳高动作，这种动作根本不可能通过自身的数学模拟被发明出来。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Fosbury also required another element that lies behind many improvements in athletic performance: an innovation in athletic equipment.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 福斯伯里还需要一个要素，这一要素存在于许多运动成绩提升的背后：运动装备的创新。

Limits to human sporting performance are: In Fosbury’s case, it was the cushions that jumpers land on.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 在福伯里的情况下，跳跃者所接触到的缓冲物决定了跳高动作的效果。

Limits to human sporting performance are: Traditionally, high jumpers would land in pits filled with sawdust.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 传统上，跳高运动员是在装满锯末的坑中着陆的。

Limits to human sporting performance are: But by Fosbury’s time, sawdust pits had been replaced by soft foam cushions, ideal for flopping.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 但到福斯伯里的时代，锯屑坑已被柔软的泡沫垫取代，这些垫子非常适合翻滚。

Limits to human sporting performance are: In the end, most people who examine human performance are humbled by the resourcefulness of athletes and the powers of the human body.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 最终，大多数研究人类表现的人都会对运动员的机智和人体的强大力量感到惊叹。

Limits to human sporting performance are: ‘Once you study athletics, you learn that it’s a vexingly complex issue,’ says John S. Raglin, a sports psychologist at Indiana University.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: “一旦你开始研究运动领域，你就会发现这是一个极其复杂的课题，”印第安纳大学的体育心理学家约翰·S·拉格林说道。

Limits to human sporting performance are: ‘Core performance is not a simple or mundane thing of higher, faster, longer.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 核心性能并非一个简单的概念，它强调的是更高、更快、更持久的性能表现。

Limits to human sporting performance are: So many variables enter into the equation, and our understanding in many cases is fundamental.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 影响结果的变量有很多，而在许多情况下，我们的理解仍处于基础层面。

Limits to human sporting performance are: We’ve got a long way to go.’
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 我们还有很长的路要走。

Limits to human sporting performance are: For the foreseeable future, records will be made to be broken.
人类运动表现的极限尚未显现: 在可预见的未来，记录将持续被打破。
